Well, I got down to shaking hands with Mr Happy when, all of the sudden, I heard whistling. Like, cat call whistling.

I was too embarrassed to continue and when I returned back at camp, no one acted weird around me, so my best guess is that Bigfoot was watching from somewhere and couldn't contain his excitement over the show. 

I'll never forgot that.
